source.citation: Fumero-Caban JJ, Melendez-Ackerman EJ, Rojas-Sandoval J. 2022. Journal of Pollination Ecology 32:139-153

source_native_pollinator_contrast.reported_visitation_result: Mean visitation rate in Guanica was approximately twice that on Mona; island effect P < 0.001, year effect P = 0.06.
source_native_pollinator_contrast.source_reading: Guanica has lower visitor richness and extreme Apis dominance but higher visitation rate; Mona has higher visitor richness and a much more even visitor assemblage.
source_native_pollinator_contrast.boundary: Richness, species-count diversity and visitation are source-native or transparently derived assemblage diagnostics; none is relabelled as Izu FDQ.

source_native_reproductive_contrast.agamospermy: no mature fruits on either island

autogamy.reading: negligible spontaneous self-pollination; the authors conclude a pollen vector is required

source_native_reproductive_contrast.selfing_vs_outcrossing: selfing had significantly lower fruit-set and seed-set than outcrossing; outcrossing yielded nearly twice the fruits and seeds
source_native_reproductive_contrast.boundary: ISI is a selfing/outcrossing seed-set ratio, not autonomous reproductive dependency. Autogamy counts demonstrate vector dependence but are not divided by digitized Figure 4 values.

scientific_implication: The two populations show a strong pollinator-assemblage contrast while their ISI values are nearly identical. This is a useful real-data counterexample to any assumption that pollinator exposure and plant reproductive dependency are interchangeable axes. The source strengthens the need to measure both independently in Issue #91.
next_gate: Recover lawful source-native raw or tabulated tree-level visitor and breeding data if available. Without them, retain Guaiacum as a population-level joint source and do not estimate a harmonized cross-lineage moderation slope.
claim_boundary: Do not interpret the Guanica-Mona contrast as an experimental Apis effect, do not use richness as FDQ, do not infer historical floral evolution, and do not reconstruct Figure 4 treatment means by digitization in the primary analysis.
